# qcc command line

Quantcore circuits: design.json → KQC layout → simulation → parameters → feedback.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

**Options**:

* `--version`: Show version.
* `--install-completion`: Install completion for the current shell.
* `--show-completion`: Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or customize the installation.
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

**Commands**:

* `build`: Build DESIGN (.json/.py) into a KQC chip...
* `watch`: Rebuild on every save and reload KLayout...
* `components`: List available components (Quantcore, KQC,...
* `synth`: LOM-first synthesis: targets → Lj, C_Σ,...
* `mask`: Fab export with the PDK fab rules: layers...
* `review`: Open the live dashboard for DESIGN: steps,...
* `dashboard`: Live dashboard that follows the notebooks&#x27;...
* `analyse`: Job results → circuit.json → Metal LOM /...
* `sim`: Simulation jobs (HFSS/Q3D, Elmer, Palace).
* `results`: Parse, extract and store results.
* `runner`: Job runner / filesystem queue (lab server).
* `design`: design.json utilities.
* `hfss`: Ansys HFSS / Q3D projects (AEDT 2024 R1/R2).
* `circuit`: Lumped circuit (LOM): layout →...

## `qcc build`

Build DESIGN (.json/.py) into a KQC chip and write it.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc build [OPTIONS] {design}
```

**Arguments**:

* `design`: [required]

**Options**:

* `-o <path>`: Output .oas/.gds (default build/&lt;name&gt;.oas)
* `--show / --no-show`: Send to KLayout via klive  [default: no-show]
* `--keep-going`: A route that cannot be built is left out (named in the sidecar&#x27;s failed_routes, its last good route kept in &lt;name&gt;.last_good_routes.json) instead of failing the build. The default is strict.
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `qcc watch`

Rebuild on every save and reload KLayout (klive).

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc watch [OPTIONS] {design}
```

**Arguments**:

* `design`: [required]

**Options**:

* `-o <path>`
* `--klive / --no-klive`: Use klive  [default: klive]
* `--extra <path>`: More files to watch (e.g. imported modules)
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `qcc components`

List available components (Quantcore, KQC, Quantum Metal) by category, or the ports of one.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc components [OPTIONS] [cell]
```

**Arguments**:

* `cell`: Show ports of this cell (name, dotted path or metal:&lt;Class&gt;)

**Options**:

* `-c, --category <str>`: Only this category (qubit, coupler, launcher, ...)
* `-s, --source <str>`: Only this source: quantcore, kqc or metal
* `--json`: Machine-readable: refs (or ports with CELL)
* `--details`: With --json: full catalog records instead of refs
* `--all`: Include whole KQC chips and Metal routes (not cells)
* `--outline`: With CELL --json: also its bbox and a simplified outline (the KLayout placement ghost)
* `--params <str>`: With CELL: PCell parameters as JSON  [default: {}]
* `--schema`: With CELL: its editable parameters and defaults (JSON)
* `--schemas`: Every listed cell&#x27;s editable parameters in one JSON (the KLayout PCell library)
* `--oas <path>`: With CELL: write its geometry (a static cell) to this OASIS file
* `--design <path>`: With CELL --oas: build it as in this design (chip-inherited parameters, PDK junction)
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `qcc synth`

LOM-first synthesis: targets → Lj, C_Σ, Cg, λ/4 length.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc synth [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**:

* `--f-q <float>`: Qubit f01 [GHz]  [required]
* `--alpha <float>`: α [MHz]  [required]
* `--f-r <float>`: Resonator [GHz]  [required]
* `--g <float>`: g [MHz]  [required]
* `--a <float>`: [default: 10.0]
* `--b <float>`: [default: 6.0]
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `qcc mask`

Fab export with the PDK fab rules: layers 1/0–4/0, 50–53/0, 100/0, 300/301, 700, 800+, 1000/0+; --positive M1
inverts a layer. Corner rounding is on by default; the cheese is the build&#x27;s own (the PDK band unless the design
has its own cheese, which wins). Simulation exports never get either.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc mask [OPTIONS] {design}
```

**Arguments**:

* `design`: [required]

**Options**:

* `-o <path>`
* `--positive <str>`
* `--cheese / --no-cheese`: Cheese: the build&#x27;s (PDK band or the original design&#x27;s own); --no-cheese writes none  [default: cheese]
* `--round / --no-round`: PDK corner rounding (r ∝ shortest dim.)  [default: round]
* `--grid / --no-grid`: KQC&#x27;s whole-area ground grid (with_grid) instead of the PDK band  [default: no-grid]
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `qcc review`

Open the live dashboard for DESIGN: steps, goal, plots, circuit, Hamiltonian, jobs, screenshots.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc review [OPTIONS] {design}
```

**Arguments**:

* `design`: [required]

**Options**:

* `--port <int>`: [default: 8765]
* `--open-browser / --no-open-browser`: [default: open-browser]
* `--run-dir <path>`: Run directory (default build/&lt;design name&gt;)
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `qcc dashboard`

Live dashboard that follows the notebooks&#x27; tracked runs (``track.start(...)`` / ``QCC_TRACK=1``).

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc dashboard [OPTIONS] [run]
```

**Arguments**:

* `run`: Run name (build/&lt;run&gt;); default: follow the run with the latest activity

**Options**:

* `--port <int>`: [default: 8765]
* `--open-browser / --no-open-browser`: [default: open-browser]
* `--root <path>`: Folder with the run directories (default: &lt;repo&gt;/build)
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `qcc analyse`

Job results → circuit.json → Metal LOM / QuCat / SQcircuit / scqubits / QuTiP → consensus vs targets.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc analyse [OPTIONS] {design} {job}
```

**Arguments**:

* `design`: [required]
* `job`: [required]

**Options**:

* `-g, --group <str>`: Sim group (default: the job&#x27;s)
* `--run-dir <path>`: Dashboard run directory (default build/&lt;design name&gt;)
* `--readout / --no-readout`: Simulate the readout (χ from transmission) with QuTiP  [default: readout]
* `--feedback`: Also propose the next design revision (surrogate)
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `qcc sim`

Simulation jobs (HFSS/Q3D, Elmer, Palace).

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc sim [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

**Options**:

* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

**Commands**:

* `build`: Create a simulation job directory for a...
* `subset`: Export the job folder of a subset (no...
* `preview`: Print as JSON what `qcc sim subset` would...
* `auto`: Automatic simulation: subset -&gt; export -&gt;...
* `run`: Run a job locally (AEDT / Elmer / Palace)...
* `submit`

### `qcc sim build`

Create a simulation job directory for a sim group.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc sim build [OPTIONS] {design}
```

**Arguments**:

* `design`: [required]

**Options**:

* `-g, --group <str>`: [required]
* `-a, --analysis <str>`: q3d_cmatrix | hfss_eigenmode | eigenmode_epr | elmer_cap | palace_cap | palace_eig  [required]
* `-o <path>`: Job directory
* `--overwrite / --no-overwrite`: [default: no-overwrite]
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `qcc sim subset`

Export the job folder of a subset (no solve): geometry, AEDT scripts, job.json, README.md (what to run and
what to bring back) and results_template.json. Solve it by hand or elsewhere; read it back with ``qcc results
import``.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc sim subset [OPTIONS] {design}
```

**Arguments**:

* `design`: [required]

**Options**:

* `-i, --instances <str>`: Components to simulate, comma separated. q3d_cmatrix: qubits and/or their readout routes (Q1,R1), resonators cut to a stub port; eigenmode / driven: exactly these components (plus the routes joining them and the pads at a selected line&#x27;s ends), lines leaving the box end in 50 ohm
* `--default`: No --instances: the first qubit with its readout
* `--whole`: The whole chip (slow, memory hungry)
* `-o <path>`: Job folder (one box) or the folder that holds one job per box
* `-a, --analysis <str>`: q3d_cmatrix (cheap, fills the LOM) | eigenmode_epr | hfss_eigenmode | hfss_driven  [default: q3d_cmatrix]
* `--fast / --full`: Fast solver settings (default) or the analysis defaults  [default: fast]
* `--margin <float>`: Margin (um) around the selection  [default: 300.0]
* `--name <str>`: Name of the sim group(s) written into the design  [default: gui_sim]
* `--write-group / --no-write-group`: Store the sim group in the design  [default: write-group]
* `--set <str>`: Solver setting key=value, repeatable (with --full: on top of the analysis defaults), e.g. --set maximum_passes=12 --set percent_error=1
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `qcc sim preview`

Print as JSON what `qcc sim subset` would render (no file is written): the box, the components and routes in it
and every port (50 ohm edge ports, cut stubs, junction ports) with its position. The KLayout plugin draws it.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc sim preview [OPTIONS] {design}
```

**Arguments**:

* `design`: [required]

**Options**:

* `-i, --instances <str>`: Components, as for `qcc sim subset`
* `--default`: No --instances: the first qubit with its readout
* `--whole`: The whole chip
* `-g, --group <str>`: A saved sim_groups entry, as it is
* `-a, --analysis <str>`: Default q3d_cmatrix; with --group the group&#x27;s first
* `--margin <float>`: Margin (um) around the selection  [default: 300.0]
* `--name <str>`: Name of the sim group(s) the export would write  [default: gui_sim]
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `qcc sim auto`

Automatic simulation: subset -&gt; export -&gt; solve in a NEW AEDT (never the one you have open) -&gt; analyse. Fills
the LOM of the simulated components; ``qcc analyse`` / the KLayout Results tab show it against the targets.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc sim auto [OPTIONS] {design}
```

**Arguments**:

* `design`: [required]

**Options**:

* `-i, --instances <str>`: Qubits and/or readout routes, comma separated
* `--default`: No --instances: the first qubit with its readout
* `--whole`: The whole chip (slow, memory hungry)
* `-a, --analysis <str>`: [default: q3d_cmatrix]
* `--aedt <str>`: batch (a new non-graphical AEDT, default) | gui (a new window)  [default: batch]
* `--fast / --full`: Fast solver settings (default)  [default: fast]
* `--margin <float>`: Margin (um) around the selection  [default: 300.0]
* `--name <str>`: Name of the sim group(s) written into the design  [default: gui_sim]
* `--timeout <float>`: Seconds per solve before qcc stops the AEDT it started  [default: 3600.0]
* `--status <path>`: Status file (JSON) the KLayout plugin polls
* `--set <str>`: Solver setting key=value, repeatable (with --full: on top of the analysis defaults), e.g. --set maximum_passes=12 --set percent_error=1
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `qcc sim run`

Run a job locally (AEDT / Elmer / Palace) and collect results.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc sim run [OPTIONS] {job}
```

**Arguments**:

* `job`: [required]

**Options**:

* `--dry-run / --no-dry-run`: Only print the command  [default: no-dry-run]
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `qcc sim submit`

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc sim submit [OPTIONS] {job}
```

**Arguments**:

* `job`: [required]

**Options**:

* `--queue <path>`: Queue directory  [required]
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `qcc results`

Parse, extract and store results.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc results [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

**Options**:

* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

**Commands**:

* `collect`: Parse solver outputs in JOB into...
* `extract`: Extract Hamiltonian parameters from JOB...
* `import`: Read solved results back (a job folder,...
* `template`: A results.json skeleton with this design&#x27;s...
* `propose`: Propose the next design revision...
* `apply`: DESIGN with the proposal&#x27;s knobs set...
* `show`

### `qcc results collect`

Parse solver outputs in JOB into results/results.json.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc results collect [OPTIONS] {job}
```

**Arguments**:

* `job`: [required]

**Options**:

* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `qcc results extract`

Extract Hamiltonian parameters from JOB results and compare with design targets.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc results extract [OPTIONS] {design} {job}
```

**Arguments**:

* `design`: [required]
* `job`: [required]

**Options**:

* `--store <path>`: Results store (sqlite)
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `qcc results import`

Read solved results back (a job folder, its results/ folder or a results.json: format in `qcc results
template --format`), check them against the design and analyse them (the KLayout Results tab shows the outcome).

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc results import [OPTIONS] {design} {sources}...
```

**Arguments**:

* `design`: [required]
* `sources...`: Solved job folder(s) or results.json file(s)  [required]

**Options**:

* `-g, --group <str>`: Sim group the results belong to (default: from the job)
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `qcc results template`

A results.json skeleton with this design&#x27;s net names (with --format: the format description).

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc results template [OPTIONS] {design}
```

**Arguments**:

* `design`: [required]

**Options**:

* `-o <path>`: Write the skeleton here (default: print it)
* `-g, --group <str>`: [default: chip]
* `-a, --analysis <str>`: [default: q3d_cmatrix]
* `--format`: Print the results.json format description instead
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `qcc results propose`

Propose the next design revision (loop.feedback: every qubit with a LOM model and a lambda/4 or lambda/2
readout) as old -&gt; new knob values; nothing is written to the design. ``qcc results apply`` sets them.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc results propose [OPTIONS] {design}
```

**Arguments**:

* `design`: [required]

**Options**:

* `--job <path>`: Job folder(s) to analyse (default: the last run&#x27;s, else the layout estimates)
* `-o <path>`: Write the proposal (JSON) here
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `qcc results apply`

DESIGN with the proposal&#x27;s knobs set (refuses when the design changed since the proposal).

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc results apply [OPTIONS] {design} {proposal}
```

**Arguments**:

* `design`: [required]
* `proposal`: proposal.json from `qcc results propose -o`  [required]

**Options**:

* `-o <path>`: Write the new design here (default: overwrite DESIGN)
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `qcc results show`

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc results show [OPTIONS] {design}
```

**Arguments**:

* `design`: [required]

**Options**:

* `--store <path>`: [default: results.sqlite]
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `qcc design to-python`

Write a readable Python script (the Designer API) that rebuilds DESIGN: the GUI prototype continues as code.

The script writes the design.json again (``python design.py``); the round trip is checked (same ``qcc design
hash``). Entries the Designer calls cannot say are written as plain data with a comment.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc design to-python [OPTIONS] {design}
```

**Arguments**:

* `design`: [required]

**Options**:

* `-o <path>`: Output script (default: &lt;design name&gt;.py next to the design)
* `--check / --no-check`: Run the script here and require the same design hash (default on)  [default: check]
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `qcc hfss`

Ansys HFSS / Q3D projects (AEDT 2024 R1/R2).

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc hfss [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

**Options**:

* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

**Commands**:

* `render`: Render DESIGN (whole chip or a sim group)...
* `solve`: Solve an exported Ansys JOB directory (new...
* `check`: Read JOB&#x27;s rendered .aedt back: stack,...
* `collect`: Re-export a solved job from its saved...

### `qcc hfss render`

Render DESIGN (whole chip or a sim group) into an AEDT project: geometry, stack, ports, Lj boundaries.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc hfss render [OPTIONS] {design}
```

**Arguments**:

* `design`: [required]

**Options**:

* `-g, --group <str>`: &#x27;chip&#x27; (whole chip) or a sim_groups name  [default: chip]
* `-a, --analysis <str>`: eigenmode_epr (default) | hfss_eigenmode | q3d_cmatrix | hfss_driven  [default: eigenmode_epr]
* `-o <path>`: Job directory (default build/jobs/&lt;sim name&gt;)
* `--solve / --no-solve`: Also solve (qcc_solve.py in a new non-graphical AEDT) and collect results  [default: no-solve]
* `--set <str>`: Solver setting key=value (JSON value), repeatable, e.g. --set percent_error=1 --set mesh_size={&quot;1t1_gap&quot;:10}
* `--airbridges / --no-airbridges`: Keep airbridges in the simulated geometry (default: the group&#x27;s setting, else dropped)
* `--timeout <float>`: Seconds before qcc kills the AEDT process tree it started
* `--open`: Open the rendered project in a new AEDT GUI
* `--graphical / --no-graphical`: Run the render with the AEDT window instead of -ng  [default: no-graphical]
* `--aedt <str>`: batch (new -ng AEDT, default) | gui (new AEDT window, left open) | attach (the open AEDT)
* `--show / --no-show`: Also send the chip to KLayout via klive  [default: no-show]
* `--dry-run / --no-dry-run`: Export the job and print the AEDT command only  [default: no-dry-run]
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `qcc hfss solve`

Solve an exported Ansys JOB directory (new batch AEDT, a new window or the open AEDT) and collect results.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc hfss solve [OPTIONS] {job}
```

**Arguments**:

* `job`: [required]

**Options**:

* `--timeout <float>`: Seconds before qcc kills the AEDT process tree it started
* `--graphical / --no-graphical`: Run with the AEDT window instead of -ng  [default: no-graphical]
* `--aedt <str>`: batch (new -ng AEDT, default) | gui (new AEDT window, left open) | attach (the open AEDT)
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `qcc hfss check`

Read JOB&#x27;s rendered .aedt back: stack, metal sheets, ports / terminations, nets and every solver setting.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc hfss check [OPTIONS] {job}
```

**Arguments**:

* `job`: [required]

**Options**:

* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `qcc hfss collect`

Re-export a solved job from its saved project as it is now (no solve), e.g. after you changed the setup in AEDT
and solved there; then ``qcc results import DESIGN JOB``. Close the project in your own AEDT first, or run
``scripts/qcc_collect.py`` in that AEDT (Tools &gt; Run Script) instead.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc hfss collect [OPTIONS] {job}
```

**Arguments**:

* `job`: [required]

**Options**:

* `--aedt <str>`: batch (a new non-graphical AEDT, default) | gui (a new window)  [default: batch]
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `qcc circuit`

Lumped circuit (LOM): layout → circuit.json, LOM simulation, circuit → layout.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc circuit [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

**Options**:

* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

**Commands**:

* `export`: Layout → LOM netlist: components&#x27; lumped...
* `simulate`: LOM simulation: QuCat normal modes +...
* `layout`: LOM -&gt; layout: transmon + lambda/4 pairs...

### `qcc circuit export`

Layout → LOM netlist: components&#x27; lumped models joined along routes/snaps (values = component estimates).

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc circuit export [OPTIONS] {design}
```

**Arguments**:

* `design`: [required]

**Options**:

* `-g, --group <str>`: &#x27;chip&#x27; (all) or a sim_groups name  [default: chip]
* `-o <path>`: Output circuit.json (default build/&lt;name&gt;.circuit.json)
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `qcc circuit simulate`

LOM simulation: QuCat normal modes + kappa, QuTiP dressed spectrum -&gt; f_q, alpha, f_r, chi, kappa.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc circuit simulate [OPTIONS] {source}
```

**Arguments**:

* `source`: circuit.json, or a design (its layout LOM is used)  [required]

**Options**:

* `--job <path>`: Fill capacitances from this simulation job (design input only)
* `-g, --group <str>`: [default: chip]
* `--json <path>`: Also write the result (modes, params, netlist values) as JSON
* `--png <path>`: Also draw the circuit schematic (matplotlib) to this PNG
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `qcc circuit layout`

LOM -&gt; layout: transmon + lambda/4 pairs with targets -&gt; knobs -&gt; a laid-out feedline chip.

**Usage**:

```console
$ qcc circuit layout [OPTIONS] {circuit}
```

**Arguments**:

* `circuit`: [required]

**Options**:

* `-o <path>`: Output design.json  [required]
* `--live / --no-live`: Lay it out live in KLayout  [default: no-live]
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.
